999008199.text:
ふぅ……狂暴ではあったが、
対処できないほどではなかったな

localizations.en: Phew... They were vicious, but it's nothing we couldn't handle.

999008199.text:
無論、私たちが九偉人だからであって、
一般人ならば到底かなわない相手だろうが……

localizations.en: Of course, that's only because we're among the Miraculous Nine. An ordinary person wouldn't stand a chance against them...

999008199.text:
……おかしい、数が少なすぎます。
この程度の数と力で「管理」対象に選ばれるわけが……

localizations.en: ...Something's wrong. There are far too few of them. Without the requisite numbers and power level, there's no way they'd be candidates for management...

999008199.text:
翼……そうか……彼らにはこの狭い島を飛び出し
海を渡る力がある……

localizations.en: Wings...? Of course! They have the power to leave this small island and cross the sea...

999008199.text: リーベ？　どうした？

兄様、集落へ速やかに帰還することを提案します。
魔物はまだ上空……別動隊が存在する可能性が高い

localizations.en: Brother, I suggest we return to the settlement immediately. The monsters are still airborne... There's a high probability that a separate group exists.

999008199.text: ぐっ……あああぁぁっ！！
少年！！　この魔物、離れろっ！！

localizations.en: Get away from that monster, boy!

999008199.text: うぅ……足、足が……
大丈夫か！？

止血さえすれば命に別状は……
しかし、脚の状態は酷いですね。これではもう……

localizations.en: As long as we stop the bleeding, his life won't be in danger... However, his leg isn't looking too good. He won't be able to...

999008199.text:
お、俺のことはいいから、村を……
あいつら、村に飛んでった……！

localizations.en: F-forget about me, the village... They flew toward the village...!

999008199.text:
そんな……誤判断だ……
追い返さなかったら……皆を、守れず……

localizations.en: No... I misjudged... If only I hadn't sent him away... I couldn't protect everyone...

999008199.text: 兄様！　気を強く持ってください！！

少年の言う通りです。彼は歩けませんが命はあります。
茂みに隠しておいて、集落へ戻りましょう

localizations.en: The boy is right. He can't walk, but he's alive. Let's hide him in the bushes and rush to the settlement.

999008199.text: いや、私がおぶる。みんなで村へ帰るんだ

localizations.en: No, I'll carry him. We're going back to the village together.

999008199.text: ……え？　しかし、それは効率が……

もう、二度と置いていかない。
守るべきものを、家族を……

localizations.en: I won't leave anyone behind ever again. Not those who fall to me to protect, not family...

999008199.text:
兄様……しまった、
悪い方向に進んでしまいましたか……

localizations.en: Oh no, this has taken a turn for the worse...

999008199.text:
それと少年、さっきのセリフはいただけないな。
こういうときは泣きながら「助けてお兄ちゃん」だろ？

localizations.en: Also, boy, don't you speak like that again! In times like this, you should be crying for help, alright?

999008199.text:
殊勝な心掛けだが、子どもが大人ぶったらいけない。
さ、泣いてごらん。助けを求めてごらん……泣け

localizations.en: It's an admirable attitude, but children shouldn't try to act like adults. Come on, cry. Ask for help... Cry.

999008199.text:
少年、悪いことは言いません。その通りにしたほうが
良いでしょう。でないと死期が早まります

localizations.en: Boy, I'm telling you this for your own good. You'd better do as he says. Otherwise, you won't survive for very long out there.

999008199.text: ……っく、ひっく、う、うわあぁぁっん！！！

よしよし。大丈夫、私は君を見捨てないぞ。
死んでも、守ってやる

localizations.en: There, there. It's okay, I won't abandon you. Even if it kills me, I'll protect you.
